items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (BlockStrap RCE and multiple other vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This update addresses eleven vulnerabilities, five of which are exploitable without authentication. The most critical, CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap), is a template engine injection allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution (CVSS 10.0). Another critical flaw, CVE-2026-92909, allows unauthenticated code execution in B2B (CVSS 9.8).

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler RCE)
items.summary: This emergency security update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650), dubbed 'StyleSmuggler', that could result in unauthenticated arbitrary code execution (CVSS 10.0). Adobe is aware of this vulnerability being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication. These include critical, important, and moderate flaws that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce (SessionReaper)
items.summary: This unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability has seen active exploitation starting October 22, 2026, approximately six weeks after Adobe's emergency patch. Many stores remain vulnerable.
